headline: A repeatable pattern shows up on expiry‑day trades.

expiry_day_trading.why_it_matters: The cost of this pattern is ₹1,16,891, coming from 90 expiry‑day trades that together produced a loss of ₹1,16,891. On average each of those trades lost ₹1,299, with a win rate of 29% and an average return loss of 28%. By contrast, the other 124 trades had an average return loss of 5%, an average loss of ₹449 and a win rate of 37%.
expiry_day_trading.rule: Set a hard cap on expiry-day trades before the open.

closing: Consider using this rule to shape your expiry‑day trading next month.
